records.jp: これは……？
records.en_original: What's that?
records.en_auxiliary: What's that?
records.en: What is this...?

records.jp: 前に、友達と一緒に飾ったことがあるのです
records.en_original: I once decorated one of these together with a friend.
records.en_auxiliary: I once decorated one of these together with a friend.
records.en: I once decorated one of these together with a friend.

records.jp: その子の学校で行われる、七夕祭りに招待されて……<CR>
records.en_original: She invited me to a event her school had for Tanabata...
records.en_auxiliary: She invited me to a event her school had for Tanabata...
records.en: A friend invited me to the Tanabata festival<CR>held at her school...

records.jp: ねえ、二人はどんな願い事を書いたの？
records.en_original: What did you write for your wish?
records.en_auxiliary: What did you write for your wish?
records.en: What wishes did you two write down?

records.jp: 私は――
records.en_original: Well...
records.en_auxiliary: Well...
records.en: Mine was—

records.jp: 大切な人たちと、ずっと一緒にいられますように
records.en_original: I wished that I could stay with the people I care about forever.
records.en_auxiliary: I wished that I could stay with the people I care about forever.
records.en: I wished that I could stay with the people I care about forever.

records.jp: ……私も、同じようなことを書いたわ
records.en_original: I wrote the same.
records.en_auxiliary: I wrote the same.
records.en: I wrote something similar.

records.jp: さすが姉妹。通じ合ってるんだね
records.en_original: You two really are sisters, huh? Totally in sync.
records.en_auxiliary: You two really are sisters, huh? Totally in sync.
records.en: You two really are sisters, huh? Totally in sync.

records.jp: えへへ……
records.en_original: Hahaha...
records.en_auxiliary: Hahaha...
records.en: Ehehe...

records.jp: （わたしは知ってる。この二人には、<CR>離れ離れになった時期があることを）
records.en_original: (I know that one day these two will be separated from one another.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I know that one day these two will be separated from one another.)
records.en: (I know that these two were once<CR>separated from each other.)

records.jp: （そしてそんな苦難を乗り越え、<CR>また一緒になれたことを）
records.en_original: (That they will have to overcome great hardships in order to be together again.)
records.en_auxiliary: (That they will have to overcome great hardships in order to be together again.)
records.en: (And that after overcoming that hardship,<CR>they found each other again.)

records.jp: （だから、きっと何度離れ離れになっても、<CR>この二人は――）
records.en_original: (But I know no matter how far apart they are, they will always—)
records.en_auxiliary: (But I know no matter how far apart they are, they will always—)
records.en: (So no matter how many times they are separated,<CR>these two will surely—)

records.jp: お姉ちゃん……？
records.en_original: Mio...?
records.en_auxiliary: Mio...?
records.en: Onee-chan...?

records.jp: お姉ちゃん！？
records.en_original: Mio?!
records.en_auxiliary: Mio?!
records.en: Onee-chan?!

records.jp: お姉ちゃん！！
records.en_original: Mio!!
records.en_auxiliary: Mio!!
records.en: Onee-chan!!

records.jp: 陽桜莉……ちゃん？
records.en_original: Hiori...?
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori...?
records.en: Hiori...-chan?

records.jp: え……あなたは……？
records.en_original: What...? Who are you?
records.en_auxiliary: What...? Who are you?
records.en: What...? Who are you?

records.jp: 平原、陽桜莉さん……だよね？
records.en_original: That's Hiori Hirahara...?
records.en_auxiliary: That's Hiori Hirahara...?
records.en: Hirahara Hiori-san... right?

records.jp: う、うん。<CR>わたしのよく知る、陽桜莉ちゃんで間違いないよ……
records.en_original: Y-yeah. This is definitely the Hiori I know...
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yeah. This is definitely the Hiori I know...
records.en: Y-yeah.<CR>There is no mistaking her for the Hiori-chan I know...

records.jp: と、とりあえずみんな呼んでくる！<CR>こころは陽桜莉さんを見てて！
records.en_original: All right, I'll go get the others, you look after her!
records.en_auxiliary: All right, I'll go get the others, you look after her!
records.en: I-I'll go get everyone for now!<CR>Kokoro, keep an eye on Hiori-san!

records.jp: 分かった！
records.en_original: Okay!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay!
records.en: Okay!

records.jp: 平原陽桜莉さんがグループに参加しました
records.en_original: Hiori Hirahara joined the group.
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori Hirahara joined the group.
records.en: Hirahara Hiori-san joined the group.

records.jp: 私は平原陽桜莉。<CR>陽桜莉でいいよ
records.en_original: I'm Hiori Hirahara, but just call me Hiori.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm Hiori Hirahara, but just call me Hiori.
records.en: I'm Hirahara Hiori.<CR>You can just call me Hiori.

records.jp: 私は星崎愛央。<CR>よろしくね
records.en_original: I'm Ao Hoshizaki. Nice to meet you.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm Ao Hoshizaki. Nice to meet you.
records.en: I'm Hoshizaki Ao.<CR>Nice to meet you.

records.jp: ところで、お姉さんを探していたと聞きましたけど……<CR>平原さんは、過去の記憶がありますか？
records.en_original: I heard you're looking for your sister. Do you remember anything from before you came here?
records.en_auxiliary: I heard you're looking for your sister. Do you remember anything from before you came here?
records.en: By the way, I heard you were looking for your older sister...<CR>Do you have any memories of your past, Hirahara-san?

records.jp: 記憶……
records.en_original: Remember...?
records.en_auxiliary: Remember...?
records.en: Memories...

records.jp: 言われてみると、なんで私、ここにいるんだろ。<CR>何にもわからないや……
records.en_original: Now that you mention it, why am I even here? I don't understand any of this...
records.en_auxiliary: Now that you mention it, why am I even here? I don't understand any of this...
records.en: Now that you mention it, why am I here?<CR>I don't understand anything...

records.jp: でも、私にはお姉ちゃんがいて……。<CR>お姉ちゃんを探さなくちゃってことだけはわかるんだ
records.en_original: All I know is that I have a sister, and I have to find her no matter what.
records.en_auxiliary: All I know is that I have a sister, and I have to find her no matter what.
records.en: But I know I have an older sister...<CR>and that I have to find her.

records.jp: 私にとってのユズとライムみたいな感じかな……？
records.en_original: She must be to you like Yuzu and Lime are to me.
records.en_auxiliary: She must be to you like Yuzu and Lime are to me.
records.en: Perhaps she is to you what Yuzu and Lime are to me...?

records.jp: 大丈夫、きっと思い出せるよ。<CR>私たちみたいに
records.en_original: It's okay, you will get your memories back. Just like all of us.
records.en_auxiliary: It's okay, you will get your memories back. Just like all of us.
records.en: Do not worry. I am sure you will remember,<CR>just as we did.

records.jp: 順番に説明しよう。<CR>えっと……どこから説明すればいいんだ？
records.en_original: We should give her the rundown. Hmm, where do we start...?
records.en_auxiliary: We should give her the rundown. Hmm, where do we start...?
records.en: Let us explain everything in order.<CR>Um... where should we begin?

records.jp: ユズ先生！
records.en_original: Professor Yuzu!
records.en_auxiliary: Professor Yuzu!
records.en: Yuzu-sensei!

records.jp: ……なんで私
records.en_original: ...Why me
records.en_auxiliary: ...Why me
records.en: ...Why me?

records.jp: 一番状況を理解してるでしょ？
records.en_original: You understand the most about our situation!
records.en_auxiliary: You understand the most about our situation!
records.en: You understand the most about our situation!

records.jp: ……はあ、まあいいけど
records.en_original: Hmph. Fine, I'll do it.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmph. Fine, I'll do it.
records.en: ...*Sigh* Fine.

records.jp: ……だから、今は外の情報を<CR>集めてるところなの。分かった？
records.en_original: ...and to that end, we're gathering information on the outside world. Understand?
records.en_auxiliary: ...and to that end, we're gathering information on the outside world. Understand?
records.en: ...So right now, we are gathering information<CR>about the outside world. Understand?

records.jp: んんんんんんん～～～～～～～……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmmmmmmmmmmmmmm...

records.jp: 分からん！！！！
records.en_original: Nope!
records.en_auxiliary: Nope!
records.en: I don't get it!!!!

records.jp: 遅れて来ましたね、反応が……
records.en_original: She had to think about it for a while...
records.en_auxiliary: She had to think about it for a while...
records.en: Her reaction came rather late...

records.jp: たくさん考えてたんだね、きっと……
records.en_original: It is a lot to take in...
records.en_auxiliary: It is a lot to take in...
records.en: She must have been thinking very hard...

records.jp: 難しいこと考えると頭痛くなっちゃうよ
records.en_original: This is too hard! My head hurts!
records.en_auxiliary: This is too hard! My head hurts!
records.en: Thinking about complicated things makes my head hurt.

records.jp: シンパシーを感じる
records.en_original: I totally get you.
records.en_auxiliary: I totally get you.
records.en: I feel a kinship.

records.jp: 通じ合わなくていいから……
records.en_original: It doesn't matter if she understands or not.
records.en_auxiliary: It doesn't matter if she understands or not.
records.en: You don't need to bond over that...

records.jp: 来たばっかりであんまり無理させるのはよくないよね。<CR>まずはゆっくりして、それから考えようよ
records.en_original: You've only just arrived. You don't have to push yourself. Take your time for now, we'll think things through together later.
records.en_auxiliary: You've only just arrived. You don't have to push yourself. Take your time for now, we'll think things through together later.
records.en: She has only just arrived, so we should not push her too hard.<CR>Let her rest first, and we can think about everything later.

records.jp: ねえねえ陽桜莉さん。<CR>何か食べたいものとか飲みたいものとかない？
records.en_original: Hey, Hiori, you hungry or thirsty at all? Anything you want?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Hiori, you hungry or thirsty at all? Anything you want?
records.en: Hey, Hiori-san.<CR>Is there anything you would like to eat or drink?

records.jp: 食べたいもの……
records.en_original: Something I want...
records.en_auxiliary: Something I want...
records.en: Something I want...

records.jp: ……カレー。<CR>カレーが食べたいな
records.en_original: Curry. I'd love some curry.
records.en_auxiliary: Curry. I'd love some curry.
records.en: ...Curry.<CR>I want curry.

records.jp: カレーですね。<CR>任せてください！
records.en_original: Curry, is it? Leave it to me!
records.en_auxiliary: Curry, is it? Leave it to me!
records.en: Curry, then.<CR>Leave it to me!

records.jp: えっ、作れるの……？
records.en_original: You can make it...?
records.en_auxiliary: You can make it...?
records.en: You can make it...?

records.jp: 今あるものからだって作れる！<CR>これまでだってそうしてきたし！
records.en_original: Yup! We got the stuff on hand! How do you think we made it this far?
records.en_auxiliary: Yup! We got the stuff on hand! How do you think we made it this far?
records.en: We can make it from whatever we have!<CR>That is how we have managed until now!

records.jp: よーし、じゃあとびっきり美味しいのを作ろう！
records.en_original: Yeah! Let's make some magic in the kitchen!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! Let's make some magic in the kitchen!
records.en: All right, let's make the tastiest curry ever!
